column3: Empty indexable /category/bitcoin/ (0 posts) plus thin /category/defi/ (2 posts) and /category/press/ (1 post) while empty sibling categories (ethereum, altcoins, exchanges, regulation) are correctly noindexed
Cross-page cannibalization: /press/ vs /category/press/ and /pages/todays-combo/ vs /category/todays-combo/ - two indexable URLs serve identical post lists

Title-tag truncation on 8+ indexable pages (60-80 chars with '| The DESI Sikka' suffix): 5 learn guides (69-80), hyundai post (72), predict-fun post (70), welcome post (69); all WOTD posts borderline (61-62)
15 near-duplicate Binance WOTD posts target one query cluster (Binance WOTD Answers Sept N, 2026) with identical bodies and shared cover image - cannibalization + thin differentiation
dateModified and article:modified_time never render because no post sets last_modified_at - freshness signal dead for Google News/Discover
RSS/Atom/JSON feeds have no per-item image (media:content/enclosure); Atom autodiscovery points to plugin feed.xml not the custom atom.xml
og:image:width/height only emitted for site default image; post covers omit dimensions
opinion: true is policy-only; no enforcement. A future prediction post ships as plain NewsArticle without Opinion label
Build artifacts published to production site root: opencode.json, seo_audit_report.md/csv, scripts/ plus orphan bharat-by-day.html demo (only page-level noindex, not robots-disallowed)
4 noindex, empty category pages (ethereum, altcoins, regulation, exchanges) still linked in global footer and llms.txt - wasted crawl and link equity
Heavy images: logo.png 624.6 KB (og/publisher-schema/welcome cover) and predictfun-developer-dashboard-hero.jpg 366.3 KB (LCP on that post)
Homepage title is bare brand 'The DESI Sikka' (14 chars) - no keyword or CTR value
sitemap.xml lacks lastmod on category/static/author/legal/hub entries
security.txt Canonical points to /thedesisikka/.well-known/security.txt which 404s because Jekyll drops dot-directories from _config includes
Unminified CSS (52 KB) and JS (16 KB) - no build-time minification
llms.txt category list stale (missing new News category); Welcome post first paragraph (24 words) fails the 40-60-word direct-answer AEO test
2 posts have empty tags (2026-09-01); tag taxonomy under-used beyond combo/featured
